changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Validate existing tenant user data before deriving username from email. Fresh go-live schemas already have username and mark this repair step as ran.

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Repair existing tenant schemas by moving client-plane login from email-only to username. Existing emails become usernames; email remains optional contact metadata.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE "${schema}"."user" SET username = LOWER(TRIM(email)) WHERE username IS NULL;

rollback.sql: UPDATE "${schema}"."user" SET email = username WHERE email IS NULL OR TRIM(email) = '';
